main.name: Barbara Bontempo
main.description: I help some of the world's largest companies get real value out of complex data, AI, and observability platforms.
main.bio: Technical Account Manager at Datadog with a background in solutions engineering. I work with Fortune 500 enterprises in healthcare and automotive, helping them drive ROI from observability and monitoring investments. Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
main.contactmessage: Let's chat! Or collab on a project!

resume.skillmessage: Observability specialist with deep expertise across the Datadog platform, cloud infrastructure, and customer-facing technical work.

education.description: Intensive full-stack engineering program covering Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, React, and SQL.

work.title: Technical Account Manager
work.description: Manage 4 enterprise accounts with a combined $28.9M ARR book of business, including Fortune 500 organizations in healthcare and automotive. Drove 73% ARR growth at UnitedHealth Group and 119% at Toyota Motor North America over two years. Mentor new TAM team members and created playbooks and enablement resources to standardize best practices across the team.

work.title: Technical Account Manager 2
work.description: Closed the first TAM contract in the LATAM region — a $140K deal. Supported the largest Brazilian customer in their full migration to Datadog, leading enablement sessions in Portuguese and growing their investment from $128K to $374K. Bridged Product Managers and customer teams to ensure customer feedback shaped the product roadmap.

work.title: Senior Solutions Engineer – APM
work.description: Built virtual sandboxes with APM enabled across popular customer stacks to streamline troubleshooting. Resolved 80+ APM customer tickets per month and led APM enablement sessions and office hours to upskill the broader solutions engineering team.

work.title: Solutions Engineer
work.description: Supported customers through tickets, live chat, and troubleshooting calls. Led demos to prospective customers, contributing to $400K in closed deals annually.
